proof.verdict: A street built in Blender from one sentence, a camera move along it, then a flood through the same move, with an original score. The flood works: water fills the street and the move holds. The set doesn't: the boxes standing in for cars and the grey blocks at the end of the street still look like a blockout, because the keyframe edit didn't dress them. The brief asked for golden hour and the light came out flat. We checked the score by measurement only.
proof.peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.

proof.verdict: An invented model and a coat on a mannequin; the coat goes onto the same person with its colour, lapels and buttons, and she walks in it. Face, jeans and shoes hold through the clip. Two things to know: we asked for four gold buttons and got a double-breasted coat with eight, and the worn coat ends at the knee where the mannequin's reached mid-calf. The try-on stage uses a LoRA that is rent-only at its source, so treat this result as non-commercial.
